evidence.quote: The composition and microstructure of TiAl alloys have a significant impact on their mechanical properties.
TiAl3, TiH2 and Fe powders are mixed with D50 particle sizes of 20.2 μm, 20.4 μm and 23.3 μm respectively.
The green body was sintered and insulated at two temperatures of 600 ◦C 800 ◦C and 1300 ◦C. The final relative density of the sintered sample reached 98.3 ± 0.14%.
HIPed samples are obtained by non-capsule HIP of sintered samples at 1250 ◦C for 3–5 hours, the relative density could be increased to more than 99.9%.

The microstructure of sintered alloy comprises α2/ γ lamellar colonies and composite structure. The average size of the α2/ γ lamellar colonies is approximately 53 μm, and the size between α2 and γ lamellae is approximately 100 nm.
The composite structure comprises irregular granular τ2 phase, α2 phase and large granular γ phase distributed at the grain boundaries.
